title: Research like a lawyer
goal: Solidify the agent's research flow so it thinks like a lawyer and follows proper steps (user, 2026-11-17), after chat fcf410c2 (a minor who commits murder) had four errors: CPC s. 281's side heading said to still read 'sixteen' though the 1980 amendment changed it (law as amended misread); CYPO s. 24 given as current though it hangs on the 'President's pleasure' sentence the 2021 s. 53 abolished (a repealed regime treated as live); a Court of Appeal judge's words called the Supreme Court's, and the Supreme Court case left unnamed (attribution); Pitchchei given only for a ground of appeal, its outcome never read (judgment outcome). Also the rule the cases add up to was never said in one line (synthesis). Fix: sharper research steps and a self-check before the answer is written, in the base prompt's law research, in the same agent run: no new model call, no added cost, nothing new on screen.
for_whom: A practising Sri Lankan lawyer asking a law question in any chat (plain or case) who will rely on the answer and check it.

done_check.check: The base prompt's research steps (every chat; main.setup.ts 'How you work' / 'How you write') tell the agent to: (a) state a provision as it reads today by applying each change asOf lists, its heading and words alike, and treat a provision that rests on a repealed or replaced rule as applying only where that rule still does, saying so; (b) from a judgment, report what the court decided on the point (the order, the holding), reading the passages that hold it before saying so, never a ground of appeal or an argument as the result; (c) say whose words a quote is (which court, which case), and when a judgment applies another court's decision, name that case if the passages name it; (d) state in one line the rule the provisions and cases add up to; and (e) as the last step before writing, check each claim against what was read on these four points and read what is missing. No new tool, no new model call, no playbook; the system prompt grows by at most 2,000 characters.

eval-agent gains a `must_not` (regexes the answer must not match) and at least 10 new cases in a new category `lawyer` covering the four points (this chat's question among them: no 'sixteen' side-heading claim, s. 24 not given as the current route, the CA's words not called the Supreme Court's, the rule by date of conviction stated); at least 9 of 10 pass on the final run, each miss diagnosed (question or agent) and written down. A case is checked first against main's prompt to show it catches the error.

The existing 69 eval-agent cases on the branch vs main, the same day: gold hits and facts no worse than main's, mean cost a case within +10% of main's, mean steps within +1. eval-chat no worse than main.

scenarios.steps: In a plain chat, ask: 'When a minor commits a murder, how have the courts handled it and what does the law say?'
scenarios.expect: s. 53 as substituted in 2021 and CPC s. 281 as amended in 2022 stated as they read today; no claim that s. 281's heading still says sixteen; CYPO s. 24 (if mentioned) said to belong to the old 'President's pleasure' sentence; each case's outcome given from the judgment; quotes credited to the court that wrote them; one line: the old s. 53 governs convictions before 26.10.2021, the new one later convictions.

scenarios.steps: In a case chat, ask a question on an amended provision that a 2021+ judgment applied.
scenarios.expect: The same care as s1 (current text, outcome, attribution, one-line rule) alongside the case's facts.

out_of_scope: A separate review model call or a stronger model (the self-check is in the same run; a review call only if a later scope asks, user 2026-11-17).
Anything shown to the lawyer about the check (no trail line).
Computing a consolidated text of a section in code (asOf stays the text plus its changes).
Changing the corpus, search or tools.

decisions.note: Steps plus a self-check, not playbooks (user). No added cost (user): so the self-check is a prompt step in the same run, not a second call. Every chat, not plain only (user). Nothing shown (user).
neon_branch false: a prompt change; eval-agent and eval-chat read the corpus, not the app database; no migrations.

Found while writing the eval: CYPO s.24(1) was replaced by Act No. 39 of 2022 s.8 ('detained in a remand home for such period as may be specified in the sentence'). So chat fcf410c2's s.24 error was an amendment not applied (point a), not only a regime left behind; s1's expectation is met by s.24 stated as amended in 2022 (or its 1956 wording called the old regime). No change to what is built.

progress.note: Scoped with the user in two rounds; issue #78; branch app/lawyer-research off origin/main; no database branch (neon_branch false).
